title: Observability: provider selection at sess_init logged only at pr_debug, invisible in production
description: ioctl_init logs 'init dispatched to provider' only at pr_debug (fd.c:777). pr_debug is compiled out or requires CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG + runtime activation — invisible in a standard production kernel. A support engineer cannot determine post-hoc which provider handled a session from dmesg alone without enabling dynamic debug before the event. KEY_IMPORT and KEY_GENERATE do not even have a pr_debug for provider selection. GET_STATE ioctl returns the provider name to the calling application, but that requires the application to query it; there is no passive audit trail in the kernel log.
